Mark tag with double equal highlight style

```swift title="Swift"

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"highlight_style\":\"DoubleEqual\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Text with <mark>highlighted</mark> here.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
